name: nuvio-scrapers
description: hydrahd and laroza scrapers for the nuvio app. each site resolves its own live domain before scraping.

providers.name: HydraHD
providers.description: hydrahd movies and series. resolves the live domain from hydrahd.info, pulls the server list from the site ajax layer, and resolves embeds to direct m3u8/mp4 links.
providers.author: b0dr7

providers.name: Laroza
providers.description: laroza movies and series (arabic subtitles/dubs). follows the laroza.to redirect to the current live domain, searches by title, and resolves the packed player to a direct m3u8 link.
providers.author: b0dr7
